title: SCE expects to shut off our power soon
text:
⚡ Power shutoff expected — our circuit (Orion)
As of 5:18 AM, SCE expects to shut off our power, typically within 1 to 4 hours.
Charge phones and batteries now, and know how to open your garage door by hand. A closed fridge stays cold about 4 hours, a full freezer about 2 days.
SCE status: sce.com/outagemap
Live info: https://tesorohighlands.com/fire
